title: parastemon urophyllus
intro: Parastemon urophyllus, commonly known as "Tongkat Ali", is a plant species in the family Peraceae, native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including enhancing male fertility, improving sexual function, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Parastemon urophyllus are attributed to its ability to stimulate the production of testosterone, improve mood, and reduce stress levels, making it a popular natural remedy for enhancing physical performance and overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Parastemon urophyllus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and quassinoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
